topics.name: Expose Form Candidate Binding
topics.purpose: Define form editing as a candidate buffer over exact fields/resources with parsing, validation and semantic diff before any write.

semantics.target_rule: Form fields bind exact destination resource/schema/field identities.
semantics.parse_rule: UI text/input parses into typed candidate values.
semantics.write_rule: Apply creates exact Operation Request/DWH mutation through normal governance.
semantics.cancel_rule: Cancel discards candidate without mutating source.
semantics.authority_rule: Editing candidate grants no write authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: valid form auto-saves without explicit operation

references.purpose: Form Elements edit candidate state only.
